question: If the inner radius of a hemispherical bowl is 5 cm and its thickness is 0.25 cm, then find the volume of the material required in making the bowl. (use π = (22)/(7)) (Rounded up to two places of decimals).
solution:
**Given:**

If the inner radius of a hemispherical bowl is 5 cm and its thickness is 0.25 cm, then find the volume of the material required in making the bowl.

**Concept used:**

Volume fo hemisphere = 2/3 π(R³ - r³)

**Calculation:**

The volume will be,

2/3 π(R3 - r3)

⇒ 2/3 × 22/7 (5.253 - 53)

⇒ 44/21 × (144.7 - 125)

⇒ 44/21 × 19.7

⇒ 866.8 / 21

⇒ 41.276 ≈ 41.28 cm3

**∴ The correct option is 4**
